mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 2% for 3 months signals monetary easing, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS does not decline below 2% for 3 consecutive months despite other easing indicators, the 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05 in t-test).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 4% for 2 weeks triggers a contractionary monetary policy response, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS remains above 4% for less than 2 weeks without a subsequent decline, the 20-day returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05 in t-test).

mechanism_narrative: An upward crossing of the unemployment rate above 7.5% signals weakening labor market conditions, prompting a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE does not cross above 7.5% within 1 month, the 20-day returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05 in t-test).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and increase in GDP demand (GDPC1) over 1 month signals dual easing, amplifying positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < previous month's value AND GDPC1 > previous month's value
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS and GDPC1 do not move in opposite directions for 1 month, the 20-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05 in t-test).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDP demand (GDPC1) above its 5-year average for 3 months predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 does not increase above its 5-year average for 3 consecutive months despite growth indicators, the 60-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05 in t-test).

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery regime, a sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 2% for 3 months predicts stronger S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If in a post-shock recovery regime, FEDFUNDS does not remain below 2% for 3 consecutive months despite other recovery signals, the 60-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05 in t-test).

mechanism_narrative: An upward crossing of the industrial production index above 97.5% for 1 week triggers a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO does not cross above 97.5% within 1 week, the 5-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05 in t-test).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate below 6% for 2 months predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE does not fall below 6% for 2 consecutive months despite labor market improvements, the 5-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05 in t-test).
